active_hypotheses.minimum_evidence: One attributable tuned-v2 eligible decision with explicit routing, execution plan, fill, protection, fees, slippage, funding, stop or target, and resolved net PnL.
One attributable exact-source SPCX short decision and fully resolved lifecycle with routing, fill, protection, prior-close target behavior, fees, slippage, funding, excursion, and final net PnL.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The exact one-year fixed-exit control lost after costs across 1023 trades; inactivity does not justify restoring a negative route.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A preregistered independent exact-source window must become positive after costs and largest-winner removal without source or exit changes.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: Tuned-v2 adds cadence but is timing-sensitive; robust-v3 remains higher priority and cannot be displaced without compatible live evidence.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: Multiple resolved exact-v56 conflicts and lifecycles must demonstrate superior after-cost selection from tuned-v2.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: The first V56 route lifecycle resolved with complete action, entry, protection, five stop fills, costs, excursion telemetry, final flat state, and zero faults. The economic result was a $42.08606 loss and is retained without being success-shaped.

The preregistered long decision produced an exact protected lifecycle and resolved at its planned stop for -$42.08606 net. Acceptance applies only to evidence completeness, not profitability or route promotion.

All three preregistered targets lost under stress and underperformed the prior-close control; 40 and 60 bps had zero positive folds, 80 bps had one, and all scenarios retained four unresolved entry slices.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A distinct preregistered source-compatible mechanism must improve fold stability and leave-largest after-cost results over the prior-close control, resolve technical paths, and then survive independent forward validation.

hypothesis_decisions.decision_reason: All nine development long entries reconciled one-to-one to causal opening features, nominal and stress outcomes, and technical path status without OOS access. No entry filter was selected; the side remains largest-winner dependent and the negative-imbalance subset is temporally concentrated.
hypothesis_decisions.reopen_condition: A new preregistered, non-post-hoc causal mechanism must add independent evidence beyond these nine development longs and the first stopped forward long.

change_proposals.recommendation: At the next verified flat and owned-order-free boundary, cut over to a successor profile that removes long authority from the SPCX cash-open provider while retaining its short authority and leaving every BTC and HYPE route unchanged.
change_proposals.why_now: The first exact V56 SPCX long lost $42.08606; the frozen development long side had only 3 wins in 9 trades, two of three folds lost, and stress net became -$75.04559 after removing its largest winner. The pooled route was promoted primarily by the materially stronger short side.
evidence_reviewed: Exact V56 SPCX decision, fill, protection, stop execution, costs, excursion, and final flat lifecycle audit
Frozen 2026-06-08 through 2026-07-13 SPCX development replay with nominal, stress, side, fold, and largest-winner diagnostics
Preregistered 40, 60, and 80 bps long fixed-target development challenger
Preregistered nine-trade causal long entry-quality diagnosis with technical-path attribution
change_proposals.observed_problem_or_opportunity: Bidirectional pooled economics masked a brittle long side: long stress PF was 1.4133 only because of one $192.8451 winner, PF without that winner was 0.7367, fold nets were -$44.6464, +$319.8025, and -$139.3610, and the first exact forward long lost. The live reason says reversal confirmed although the mechanism does not require an opening-bar reversal.
change_proposals.applicable_market_regime: All observed regimes; this is a side-specific evidence and authority correction, not a directional macro forecast.
alternatives_considered: Continue both SPCX sides unchanged and collect more losses or wins
Reduce only SPCX long size without evidence for a calibrated fraction
Require a positive opening-bar reversal, which left one losing development trade and today also lost
Require negative top-10 imbalance, a post-hoc five-trade subset whose wins cluster in one middle fold and whose later two trades both lost
Remove the entire SPCX route, which would discard the materially stronger short-side development evidence
change_proposals.proposed_live_change: Create and verify a new successor config with the SPCX provider sides set to [short] and executable direction limited to short; do not edit or hot-reload the active V56 file. Cut over only while venue and all strategy ledgers are flat and owned-order-free. Preserve BTC and HYPE routes, leverage, margin, stops, targets, and hold policies exactly.
change_proposals.expected_upside: Prevents a weak, largest-winner-dependent long side from taking another approximately $5,000-notional 80-bps-stop exposure while preserving the route's stronger short-side opportunity and all other V56 opportunities.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: Nine development longs plus one forward long remain a small sample and disabling may miss a future winner
Four of nine development long lifecycles have unresolved entry risk slices
The short side has no exact V56 resolved lifecycle yet and its own profitability remains provisional
A malformed successor could accidentally remove the whole provider or retain hidden long authority
Restarting away from a non-flat or order-held state could orphan risk and is prohibited
